methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. Where the official page returned 404 or geo-locked to EUR (Captivate, Libsyn /pricing path), the canonical /plans-and-pricing/ URL was used or a second fetch was attempted. Captivate's pricing page renders EUR only due to geo-detection; USD prices ($19/$49/$99) are confirmed from the page's own FAQ text and corroborated by thepodcasthost.com review. Spreaker is excluded because only EUR prices were retrievable from all attempted URLs and no independent USD corroboration was found. All monthlyUsd values represent the month-to-month rate unless noted. Annual rates are captured in annualDiscountPct and plan notes. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null for all plans (non-telephony).
